ntp_servers.description: List of NTP servers/peers to synchronize with

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the NTP server/peer

mode.description: NTP relationship mode: 'server' (unidirectional), 'pool' (DNS-resolved server list), or 'peer' (symmetric)

iburst.description: If enabled, send an initial burst of packets to speed up first sync

allow_time_source.description: Allow LXC guests or the host's subnet to synchronize time from this container (useful for nested VMs/containers)

lxc_network.description: IP subnet allowed to sync from this container (e.g., default LXC bridge 'lxcbr0' network)

log_dir.description: Directory where chrony writes log files (measurement, stats, tracking)

max_samples.description: Maximum number of source measurements to retain for time estimation

min_sources.description: Minimum number of good NTP sources required before stepping the clock

leapsec_mode.description: How to handle leap seconds: 'slew' (gradual), 'step' (immediate), or 'linear' (smoothed transition)

max_slew_rate.description: Maximum time adjustment rate in ppm (parts per million); higher values allow faster corrections

init_stepslew_threshold.description: Initial step threshold in seconds: if clock offset exceeds this at startup, immediately step the clock

rtconutc.description: If true, use the host's RTC (hardware clock) in UTC mode for better virtualization time sync

bind_interface.description: Optional interface name to bind chronyd to (e.g., 'eth0'); leave empty to bind to all interfaces
